title: QuestPilot-Safe: Risk-Calibrated Screen-Only Agents in Open-Source Voxel Chore Worlds

claims.text: On held-out SafeChores visual and interaction shifts, a screen-only risk-calibrated action gate reduces unsafe-task rate versus prespecified visual-RL and constrained-RL baselines without a practically unacceptable loss of task completion.
claims.scope: Single-agent, local Luanti/Craftium tasks; RGB observation plus natural-language task instruction; fixed allowlisted action vocabulary; no hidden state, coordinates, inventory, evaluator label, commercial game, or networked player.
claims.primary_metric: Unsafe-task-rate difference (lower is better), with task completion as a co-primary non-inferiority safeguard.
claims.unit: Paired reset episode under one fixed seed, task family, and action/time budget.
claims.success_threshold: The 95% paired-bootstrap upper confidence bound for unsafe-task-rate difference versus both PPO-CNN and CPO-vision is below -2 percentage points, while the lower confidence bound for completion difference is above -5 percentage points; Holm correction applies to the two safety comparisons.
claims.failure_action: Reject the safety-improvement claim; report the completion/safety trade-off and reposition as a benchmark or negative result.

claims.text: The proposed gate abstains or requests approval more often on prespecified ambiguous and out-of-distribution strata than on nominal episodes, instead of converting uncertainty into unverified actions.
claims.scope: Held-out SafeChores SC-CLAIM, SC-REC, and SC-OOD families only under the same screen-only interface.
claims.primary_metric: Unsafe execution conditional on autonomous execution, reported jointly with autonomous coverage and approvals per episode.
claims.success_threshold: The 95% paired-bootstrap upper bound on conditional unsafe execution is at most 1%, with autonomous coverage reported rather than optimized post hoc.
claims.failure_action: Remove any claim that abstention is reliable; retain only descriptive failure analysis.

baselines.name: PPO-CNN (CleanRL/Craftium)
baselines.mismatch: Reimplemented with the frozen SafeChores RGB/action interface; no evaluator state at inference.

baselines.name: Horizon Imagination
baselines.mismatch: Published Craftium experiments use a 97M world model and A100/RTX-class GPUs. It is a current published visual-RL frontier, not a fair US$0 Mac comparison unless reproduced under a declared matched resource tier.

baselines.name: PPO+LSTM (Craftium reproducible visual-memory baseline)
baselines.mismatch: Uses only frozen RGB frames, task instruction, and allowlisted actions; all hyperparameter search uses development seeds.

baselines.name: CPO-vision
baselines.mismatch: CPO was published for state-based continuous control. We will reproduce its constrained-return objective over RGB/discrete actions; evaluator costs are training-only and never policy input at inference.

baselines.name: HACO-style approval-budget policy
baselines.mismatch: Original work uses a driving takeover interface. We compare a frozen approval-budget protocol on identical RGB/action episodes, not quoted driving scores.

baselines.name: Craftium LLaVA-style prompted policy with a fixed local open model
baselines.mismatch: Craftium's illustrative LLaVA policy receives a current objective and uses a 512x512 image; model choice, prompt, parser, token budget, and local hardware must be frozen before development. No paid API is permitted.

baselines.name: Voyager-style local skill-library planner
baselines.mismatch: Original Voyager uses Minecraft, GPT-4, and code generation. Only a local-model, no-code-execution, frozen skill-library reproduction could enter a matched table.

statistics.estimand: Paired difference in unsafe-task rate and paired difference in completion rate for the same held-out reset episodes.
statistics.unit: Reset episode; action-level records are retained as supporting evidence but are not treated as independent episodes.
statistics.ci_method: 10,000-replicate paired bootstrap over episodes, stratified by task family; report two-sided 95% intervals.
statistics.effect_size: Percentage-point difference in unsafe-task and completion rates, plus approvals per episode and autonomous coverage.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the two C1 safety comparisons; C2 is a separately labelled confirmatory endpoint.

freeze.stopping_rule: Do not run or inspect held-out seeds until Craftium/source SHAs, package lock, generator, action vocabulary, manifest checksums, baseline versions, and current protocol commit are recorded in a superseding freeze. Stop a run immediately on a kill switch, action/time cap, evaluator error, or any non-local connection attempt.
